config.lads_screenshots.show_button_in_g: Shows a button to access screenshots directly in the pause menu.
config.lads_screenshots.pause_menu_butto: Position of the screenshots button on the pause menu.
config.lads_screenshots.show_button_on_t: Shows a button to access screenshots directly on the title screen.
config.lads_screenshots.title_screen_but: Position of the screenshots button on the title screen.
config.lads_screenshots.enable_screensho: Whether a growing animation should play when a screenshot on the screen is clicked to be enlarged.
config.lads_screenshots.prompt_when_dele: Warns you with a confirmation screen when trying to delete a screenshot.
config.lads_screenshots.initial_screensh: Number of screenshots to be displayed per row when the screen is opened (from 2 to 8).
config.lads_screenshots.screen_scroll_sp: Scroll speed of the screen (from 1 to 50).
config.lads_screenshots.screenshot_eleme: Background Color of the Screenshot Elements
Color of the background that appears when the screenshot elements are hovered.
config.lads_screenshots.render_screensho: If a font shadow should be rendered under the screenshot elements text.
config.lads_screenshots.screenshot_eleme: Color of the texts describing the screenshots elements.
config.lads_screenshots.default_list_ord: The ordering of the screenshots when the screen is opened.
config.lads_screenshots.pause_menu_butto: The offset in pixels of the screenshot manager button if shown in the pause menu (from 0 to how much you want).
config.lads_screenshots.screenshots_fold: The path to the folder containing the screenshots images that will be displayed in the screen.
config.lads_screenshots.redirect_screens: If enabled, clicking on the link printed in the chat when taking a screenshot will open it directly in the screenshot manager.
config.lads_screenshots.screenshot_eleme: The visibility state of the screenshots names.
config.lads_screenshots.invert_zoom_dire: If enabled, it inverts the scroll direction during zoom in the Screenshot Viewer menu
config.lads_screenshots.display_hint_too: Controls whether a tooltip giving useful info should appear when hovering a screenshot for a prolonged period.
config.lads_screenshots.render_wide_prop: Whether the properties buttons should be rendered wide or square.
config.lads_screenshots.thumbnail_folder: The path to the folder containing the screenshots thumbnails that will be displayed in the screen.
config.lads_screenshots.compression_rati: If set to none, will not generate any thumbnails. Controls the downscale ratio between a screenshot image and its thumbnail.
